title: 📱 Huawei Launches the Mate X8 Foldable! A Crease-Free Screen and a 6,200mAh Battery!
body: 📱 Huawei Launches the Mate X8 Foldable! A Crease-Free Screen and a 6,200mAh Battery!

Huawei officially launched its foldable phone, the Mate X8, in China today, Tuesday, November 24, at an event in Beijing, with a larger 8.2-inch inner screen that the company says is almost crease-free, the new Kirin 9050 Pro chip, and a 6,200mAh battery — the largest in any of the company's foldable phones.

The inner screen uses a new magnetic system to flatten the hinge, cutting the visible crease to just 15 microns, with brightness reaching 8,000 nits, while the 6.54-inch outer screen reaches 12,000 nits. The phone is 4.2mm thick when open and 8.95mm when folded, making it thinner and lighter than its predecessor, the Mate X7.

Huawei says the new chip is 31% faster than the previous generation's chip, with a nine-core processor, a second-generation ray-tracing graphics unit, and an AI unit that is 140% faster. The cameras include a 50MP main camera, a 40MP ultra-wide camera, and a 50MP telephoto camera with 3.5x optical zoom, plus support for the detachable Ruixing Z10 camera unit.

Prices in China start at 12,999 yuan (about $1,951) and reach 20,999 yuan (about $3,152) for the top version, with open sales starting on December 4, and the company has not announced any date for a global launch yet.
Simply put: a phone that opens up into a small tablet, with a screen that is almost crease-free and a battery that lasts a full day… but its price approaches two thousand dollars in China alone.
Would you buy a foldable phone at this price?
